text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "Redis replicates asynchronously by default",
      "claim_text": "Redis uses asynchronous replication by default.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P0.S0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "replicas periodically acknowledge how much data they have received",
      "claim_text": "Replicas periodically acknowledge the amount of data they have received.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P0.S1 states replicas asynchronously acknowledge amount of data received periodically."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the master knows which replica has processed which command",
      "claim_text": "The master knows which replica has processed which command.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P0.S2 says master knows what replica processed what command."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Clients can request synchronous replication of specific writes with WAIT",
      "claim_text": "Clients can request synchronous replication of certain data using the WAIT command.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P1.S0 states this directly."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "greatly reduces, but does not eliminate, the chance of losing an acknowledged write in a failover",
      "claim_text": "WAIT greatly reduces but does not eliminate the probability of losing an acknowledged write after a failure event.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P1.S1", "rel": "entails", "sub": "acknowledged writes can still be lost during a failover"},
        {"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "entails", "sub": "probability of losing a write after a failure event is greatly reduced"}
      ],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Combines P1.S1 (can still be lost) and P1.S2 (greatly reduced)."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Within a replication history the offset works as a logical clock",
      "claim_text": "For a given replication history, the offset works as a logical time to understand who holds the most updated data set.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S4", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P3.S4 states offset works as logical time for a given history."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "if two instances share a replication ID and one is at offset 1000 while the other is at 1023",
      "claim_text": "Two instances can share a replication ID with one at offset 1000 and the other at offset 1023.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S0", "rel": "entails", "sub": "if two instances A and B have the same replication ID, but one with offset 1000 and one with offset 1023"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P4.S0 gives this example."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the first is 23 bytes of replication stream behind",
      "claim_text": "The instance at offset 1000 is 23 bytes of replication stream behind the instance at offset 1023.",
      "kind": "arith",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P4.S0", "rel": "entails", "sub": "one with offset 1000 and one with offset 1023"},
        {"sid": "P2.S1", "rel": "entails", "sub": "offset that increments for every byte of replication stream"}
      ],
      "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "1023 - 1000", "op": "==", "value": "23"},
      "reasoning": "Offset increments per byte; difference is 23."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "can reach the same state by applying just a few commands",
      "claim_text": "The instance at offset 1000 can reach the same state as the instance at offset 1023 by applying just a few commands.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P4.S1 states this."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Since Redis 2.6 replicas are read-only by default",
      "claim_text": "Since Redis 2.6, replicas support a read-only mode enabled by default.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P5.S0 states this."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a Redis 3.0 replica also starts in read-only mode unless configured otherwise",
      "claim_text": "A Redis 3.0 replica starts in read-only mode unless configured otherwise.",
      "kind": "version",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P5.S0", "rel": "entails", "sub": "Since Redis 2.6, replicas support a read-only mode that is enabled by default"},
        {"sid": "P5.S1", "rel": "entails", "sub": "can be enabled and disabled at runtime"}
      ],
      "check": {"kind": "version", "left": "3.0", "op": ">=", "right": "2.6"},
      "reasoning": "Read-only default since 2.6; 3.0 >= 2.6; configurable."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Since 2.8 a master can be set to accept writes only when at least N replicas are connected",
      "claim_text": "Starting with Redis 2.8, a master can be configured to accept write queries only if at least N replicas are currently connected.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P6.S0 states this."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "replicas ping the master every second",
      "claim_text": "Redis replicas ping the master every second.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P7.S0 states this."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "By default a replica ignores maxmemory",
      "claim_text": "By default, a replica ignores maxmemory.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P8.S0 states this."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the master drives evictions by sending DEL commands",
      "claim_text": "The master handles eviction of keys by sending DEL commands to the replica.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P8.S1 states this."
    }
  ]
}
